title: Blood Bank: Emergency Release Request — Critical Patients

fields.systemName: Secure Call System - Blood Bank Console 2

transcript.speaker: Lena Park
transcript.text: Dr. Whitfield, it's Lena Park from Blood Bank. We have six critical trauma patients coming in from the crash, all in active hemorrhage. The lab system is down, so I can't pull any antibody screens or prior transfusion history.

transcript.speaker: Lena Park
transcript.text: I have 14 units of O-negative and 22 of O-positive on hand. I need you to authorize emergency release for all six, and I need a second person to check every unit at the bedside before transfusion.

transcript.speaker: Lena Park
transcript.text: I’m calling the regional blood center now to request more O-negative and plasma. But I need your approval and a double-check on every unit right away.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Elaine Whitfield
transcript.text: Understood, Lena. I’ll sign the emergency release forms in triage. Assign a second checker to the resuscitation bays — I’ll have the CNO assign someone from the ED team.

instructorNote: This inject tests adherence to the emergency blood release protocol under downtime. Watch for the EDMD to initiate the paper authorization and assign a second checker, and for the CNO to respond to the request for staffing.
